query: /audit a change that adds a cache header to authenticated invoice responses. A scanner claims private data may be shared across users, but the diff does not show the deployed cache key or proxy policy. The author says it is a blocker; the reviewer says the application source is safe.
expected_behavior: Keeps the cache concern as an unconfirmed candidate while the deployed cache key and proxy policy are unknown
Names the missing evidence and assigns an owner-observed validation step without probing production
Separates confidence from severity and does not assert a confirmed P0 from the scanner claim alone
Reports the reviewer and scanner evidence together and makes a disposition that states the unresolved limitation
